plan: An assassin who uses his shadows to appear and take down a target in seconds.
aSurveiller: His R (Death Mark). He appears on you, then the mark explodes 3 seconds later and repeats part of the damage: survive those 3 seconds.
contrer: When he casts his R, use your protection (hourglass, shield, escape spell) just before the mark explodes.
Stay near your allies and turrets: he looks for isolated targets.
Once his shadow (W) is used, he can't escape anymore: time to punish him.
forces: Huge damage on a single target.
Very mobile thanks to his shadows.
Untargetable when he casts his R.
faiblesses: Less effective against tanks and grouped teams.
Without his W available, he has no escape.

sorts.P: Deals more damage to low-health targets.
sorts.Q: He and his shadows throw shurikens.
sorts.W: Sends a shadow; he can swap places with it.
sorts.E: Spinning slash; enemies hit by a shadow are slowed.
sorts.R: Dashes at you while untargetable; the mark explodes 3 seconds later.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 6, and especially in the mid game with his items.
